title: dvh clock-tree
description: Registers grouped by the clock that samples them.

domains.description: Domain name -> the registers it samples, sorted.

registers.description: Register name -> what its clock pin traced back to.

clock_sources.description: Sorted roots: a port, or a clock register.

gated_or_muxed.description: True if any logic was walked through.

through.description: Cells walked through, and controls skipped.

src.$comment: Constrained so a blank or a non-location cannot pass.

clock_ambiguous.description: True when clock and enable were not separable.
clock_ambiguous.$comment: Such findings are reported as undecided.

domain.description: The domain's identity: its clock net.
domain.$comment: Equal source names can still be two networks.

$comment: Gating control appears in `through`, not in the name.
